subject: Europe hosting assurance + private peering onboarding
messages:
From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@globalhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: it-sec@globalhealth.com
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: EU-only hosting assurance + private peering details (SOC2/SIG/CAIQ items)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this—our procurement and security teams are completing the SIG/CAIQ and need a short formal statement from Redwood confirming the following for our pilot: 

- Primary hosting region: EU (eu-west-1) only for production workloads; no egress to non-EU regions for customer data.
- Private connectivity options (VPC peering or PrivateLink) and expected lead times.
- KMS key residency and partitioning: whether keys are customer-dedicated and where they reside.
- Audit/logging retention and where audit logs are stored.

I've attached our current SIG workbook (GlobalHealth_SIG_Questions.xlsx) with highlighted items that are blocking our procurement review. Can you also provide a short acceptance/assurance letter we can pass to legal that references SOC 2 scope and the private deployment constraints?

Appreciate if you can loop in infra/security folks for technical details.

Best,
Alice
Alice Brown
Head of IT Security, GlobalHealth
alice.brown@globalhealth.com
+44 20 7123 4567

Attachment: GlobalHealth_SIG_Questions.xlsx (Excel workbook)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Brown <alice.brown@globalhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Request: EU-only hosting assurance + private peering details (SOC2/SIG/CAIQ items)

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to support the SIG/CAIQ items and provide an assurance letter for procurement. High-level answers below; Karthik and Grace are on copy for technical confirmation and diagrams.

- Hosting region: We can commit production traffic for your tenant to be served from eu-west-1 only. We will not route production request payloads or logs to non-EU regions unless you explicitly request a fallback policy; any fallback would require a separate mutual authorization.
- Private connectivity: We support VPC peering and PrivateLink; peering setup typically takes 1–3 weeks depending on network approval cycles. We'll provide prescriptive CIDR ranges and a peering runbook.
- KMS keys: We offer customer‑managed KMS keys. Keys for your tenant can be provisioned in the EU region and scoped to your tenant.
- Audit logs: Audit and operational logs for your tenant will be stored in the EU and retained for 1 year by default; we can extend retention on request.

Next steps: Karthik will send a network diagram + CIDR/egress controls. I'll prepare a short assurance letter that your procurement can accept, and we'll include the materials you flagged in the SIG workbook.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-regional-deployment-worksheet.pdf (worksheet: hosting commitment + next steps)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Brown <alice.brown@globalhealth.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Sep 2025 09:40:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Request: EU-only hosting assurance + private peering details (SOC2/SIG/CAIQ items)

Alice / Marissa — technical details below to land the SIG answers (summarized):

- Deployment: Tenant pinned to eu-west-1. Model weights and inference runtime will be instantiated in the eu-west-1 availability zones; no cross-region replication for production artifacts.
- Networking: We support both VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink. For peering, provide your VPC CIDR and preferred peering account; our recommended peering CIDR ranges are 10.10.240.0/20 and 10.10.248.0/21 (we can adjust). Egress to the internet is restricted via NAT gateways in the EU subnets and controlled by security groups.
- Egress control & isolation: We will apply tenant-level routing to prevent outbound pathways to non-EU destinations. Any log forwarding (e.g., to a third-party SIEM) will be configurable to target EU endpoints only.
- KMS: Customer-managed CMKs are supported. Keys can be created in the customer's KMS or we can provision a tenant-scoped key in the customer's AWS account (recommended). Key material remains in the EU key store.
- Audit/logging: Operator audit trails and request logs are retained in EU S3 buckets with server-side encryption (AES-256) and access controls. Retention: 1 year by default; longer retention available by contract.
- SOC 2 scope: For the purposes of your procurement, Redwood will include the hosting and peering operations in our SOC 2 in-scope controls where applicable; we can provide the SOC 2 attestation and a short control map for the peering/onboarding steps.

Attachments: network-diagram.svg (peering topology), kms-partitioning-note.txt (KMS scoping options).

Call to action: Please confirm your preferred connectivity option and a rough target date for cutover so we can provision a dedicated onboarding slot.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: network-diagram.svg, kms-partitioning-note.txt

From: Alice Brown <alice.brown@globalhealth.com>

Marissa / Karthik — this is very helpful, thank you. Two short follow-ups before we escalate to procurement: 

1) Can you produce a one‑page assurance letter (PDF) stating Redwood's commitment to EU-only processing for our tenant, KMS residency, and that the peering will be established to EU endpoints only? Procurement needs the signed letter for the purchase order.
2) For peering timelines: can you confirm a preferred 2‑week window in the week of Sep 22 for onboarding? Our network team is available that week.

I've attached the PO placeholder and our SIG workbook with the highlighted items still pending.

Best,
Alice

Attachment: GH_PO_Placeholder.pdf (procurement), GlobalHealth_SIG_Questions.xlsx (updated with comments)

Subject: RE: Request: EU-only hosting assurance + private peering details (SOC2/SIG/CAIQ items)

Alice — attached is a concise assurance letter and a short onboarding checklist. Legal has pre-cleared the language; we'll route the DocuSign for countersignature once you confirm procurement details.

Highlights: 
- Redwood confirms commitment to process production data for GlobalHealth in EU (eu-west-1) and not to transfer production request payloads or tenant-specific logs to non-EU regions absent written authorization.
- Customer-managed KMS keys will be used and can be kept in the customer's EU KMS.
- Peering will target EU-only endpoints and we will work with your network team during the agreed onboarding window.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm the Sep 22 week for onboarding and a preferred day/time.
2) Confirm the procurement contact and PO number so Legal can finalize the DocuSign.

Attachment: redwood-eu-hosting-letter.pdf (assurance letter), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (peering runbook summary).

Thanks,
Marissa
